general.notes: Copper Grey SFP; transmission media Electrical (1x RJ45). Typical reach 100m using CAT5e cable or better (footnote 1). Operating temperature 0°C to +70°C for SO-SFP-1000Base-TX (-TX); -40°C to +85°C for SO-SFP-1000Base-TX-I (-TX-I). temp_min_c/temp_max_c span both orderable variants. Power consumption stated as < 1.2W. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Rx LOS: No. Sync on line side: Preferred slave. Auto-negotiation: Yes, SGMII auto-neg. SGMII physical layer 1.25Gb/s, 8B10B encoded. 2-wire serial interface per SFF-8472. RoHS-6/6 compliant. 10/100/1000 BASE-T requires SGMII with no clocks in host; 1000BASE-T when host uses SERDES depends on module PHY configuration.
general.suggestions: Consider schema fields for copper/Ethernet modules: cable category (CAT5e), reach in meters, storage temperature range, Rx LOS presence, and host PHY modes (SGMII vs SERDES) without optical parameters.
